quest.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part I
quest.description: One day, you and Paimon pass through Wangshu Inn, only for a notice to attract your attention...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x45, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Recipe: The Palace Jewels x1

talks.objective: Check the notice outside Wangshu Inn

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wangshu Inn now hiring... urgently seeking 1 temporary chef, willing to pay top Mora, salary negotiable...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}! An urgent hiring notice, and they're paying "top Mora," too! Paimon likes the sound of that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Strange... Why would Wangshu Inn suddenly need a new chef?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... You're right, it is strange. Do you think something happened to Yanxiao? 'Cause that guy barely lets anyone ever set foot in his kitchen... He doesn't exactly seem like the type to hire help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The notice says interested parties should go upstairs and talk to the innkeeper, Huai'an. Should we go and see what's up?

choices.text: You want to check up on Yanxiao?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! And we can ask about the pay while we're at it!

choices.text: You want to check how much the job pays, don't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Well that, and to check up on Yanxiao, of course!

talks.objective: Ask Huai'an, the innkeeper of Wangshu Inn, for details

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...Boss, there's really no need for this. It's just a little burn, that's all. It won't get in the way of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Perhaps not, but continuing to work will only hinder your recovery. You need to rest for a few days. We'll figure something out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huai'an! Yanxiao!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: #Oh? {NICKNAME} and Paimon! What brings you to this neck of the woods?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We saw your hiring notice downstairs...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we decided to come check out— Ahem, check up on Yanxiao!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah! I knew we shouldn't have posted that notice. It's really nothing to worry about... I'm fine, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How kind of you. My thanks to you both — and thanks on Yanxiao's behalf too. There's nothing to be embarrassed about, Yanxiao. Just tell them what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Oh, alright... Well basically, we had a lot guests pouring in for the Lantern Rite... Things got busy, I started rushing, and I ended up accidentally burning my hand while plating a dish.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound like you...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, you know what they say... Play with fire long enough, and you're bound to get burned. Even the best chefs slip up sometimes. Anyway, it's nothing. Just a tiny burn, I can still—

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Now now, I don't want you pushing yourself. You'll only make it worse, and then you'll be looking at more than just a couple of days off to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But the Lantern Rite's only just finished, and we're still getting tons of guests... Now's not a good time for me to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But... Plus, lots of the guests are visiting from other nations. We can't just bring in some random chef off the street — we have a reputation to uphold! I refuse to let someone else ruin the good name we've made for ourselves here!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Heh, listen to you — anyone would think that you're the boss and not me...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: But he's not wrong. Yanxiao was one of the favorites in the Masterful Chefs tournament. No matter how you look at it, his are big boots to fill.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I don't mean to boast, but any chef of my caliber probably has their own restaurant to look after... It's not gonna be easy to find someone who's got the skills and has the time to help us out.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Mmm... Looks like we might have to increase the pay we're offering even further...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do we know anyone that's a good chef and has the time to help out...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Of course! You!

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Oh, right! Yes, now I think about it, I do recall hearing good things about your cooking ability. I suppose I'd added you to my mental list of people who can hold their own in a combat situation, but forgot you can cook.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you even keeping a mental list of people who can fight?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Heh, maybe a story for another time. More importantly — I'm sure Yanxiao would be comfortable leaving his kitchen in your hands, if anyone's. What do you think, Yanxiao?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: #Well... {NICKNAME}, since it's you... I suppose that's better than anyone else.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Should we do it?

choices.text: You said something about increasing the pay...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Haha, I did say that, didn't I? Well, I'm a man of my word — you'll be compensated generously for your work.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: I should warn you that cooking for customers is quite a different ball game from cooking for yourself. So, I'll stick around the kitchen over the next few days to help smooth things over.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh. So he's not leaving the kitchen after all.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: I believe there's some spare kitchenware here at the inn. Boss, would you mind...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Of course, of course! I'll take care of it!

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Whew, all done! Come take a look. This was made with your measurements in mind!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This carpentry is incredible! You've missed your true calling...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Ah, it's nothing. A little handicraft and elbow grease goes a long way! Alright, Yanxiao, I'll leave you to take it from here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You really went to all the trouble of building a new stovetop? What was wrong with the original? Boy, you really hate when people touch your stuff, huh?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: No, it's nothing like that. As Boss always says, hire who you trust and trust who you hire. I just thought the original setup might be a little, um... tall for you.

choices.text: Well, everyone looks short compared to you...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Ahem... Anyway, as I was saying, cooking for guests is different from cooking for yourself. Not only do you have to execute on taste, aroma, and appearance, but you also need to ensure speed, precision, and consistency.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Having the right equipment is a big part of that. Ill-suited equipment doesn't just make the job more tiring, it also slows you down, and paying customers don't have unlimited patience.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Sometimes, cooking is all about being well-prepared. That's how you ensure speed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, and what about precision and consistency?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Ah, precision all comes down to using your eyes. Where to slice into a particular cut of meat, how much oil to use, how to tell when a dish is done cooking...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: When you cook for yourself, you can always add salt if it's too bland or add water if it's too salty. You can tweak the taste as you go. But in a restaurant, there's not that much room for trial and error.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not too worried about that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Worst-case scenario, Paimon can deal with any sub-par dishes by... making sure they get properly disposed of, hehe!

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: The final thing you have to focus on is consistency. You have to be able to handle the most challenging orders with the same level of technique and skill as the easiest ones. This is particularly important when you have guests from all over, each with their own tastes and preferences.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: You have to cater to their own dietary needs while also giving them the opportunity to enjoy our local delicacies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, this last point is making Paimon's head spin...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: #Don't worry, {NICKNAME}. Matter of fact, someone as well-traveled as you may even have a better handle on it than me once you get started.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: And, of course, I'll be around to help you over the next few days. I don't think we'll have any trouble making all our guests feel right at home!

choices.text: I don't think it would be that big of a problem.
Never thought I'd see the day when Yanxiao leaves his kitchen...
Sometimes, the answer you're looking for is right under your nose...

talks.objective: Talk to Smiley Yanxiao and start work

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: There's no time to lose, so let's get started! I imagine you probably have a good handle on the cooking side of things already. What you need to pay attention to is remembering each table's order. Try not to get them mixed up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon's memory is like a steel trap! This is gonna be a cinch!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: At the end of the day...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Which ticket are we on again? Table 1 was onions, but no chilis, table 2 was chilis, but no onions... And table 3 was... Uh, table 3 was chilis, but hold the chilis...

choices.text: All the guests have already finished eating...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! ...Was Paimon just sleep-floating?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've been talking nonsense since about halfway through the day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, we didn't even get a break in the middle. Paimon's brain has turned to mush. Is it always this busy here?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: No, but this is peak season. You both did a mighty fine job for your first time serving guests at the Inn.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Luckily, all our customers were familiar faces this time around, so we didn't get any strange requests. Otherwise, today would have been even more challenging.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No strange requests!? Someone asked for Almond Tofu drizzled in soy sauce. Even Paimon has never tried that combination!

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Haha, it's a wide world out there, people have all kinds of different tastes. Being able to cater to all is the real essence of Liyue cuisine.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Also, the thing about requests is that they're usually very specific, so as long as you do what they asked, you're unlikely to have any issues. What's really tricky is when guests give you free rein to do anything you want...
Excuse me... Are you still open, by any chance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon knows that voice... Let's go check it out!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: What should we do...? It doesn't look like anyone's here... Ah, if only we'd gotten here a bit sooner...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: It's alright. If we start building a campfire now, we'll be eating before too long.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Right! Besides, if anyone's to blame, it's Lyney. So busy being a greedy culture vulture that he lost track of time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lyney, Lynette, Freminet! It IS you!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: #Paimon? So... is {NICKNAME} here...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Greetings.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! What a nice surprise!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was gonna say the same thing! We're just lending a helping hand at the Inn...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You fill the three of them in...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Anyway, so that's how we ended up here. But what about you guys? Don't tell us... "Father" sent you on another mission?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: No, quite the opposite, actually. We're in Liyue on vacation. And while we're here, I thought a cultural tour might be in order.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: "Father" said we deserved some rest after everything that happened recently. Otherwise, it could jeopardize our next mission.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: It's not every day we get this kind of opportunity. Lyney thought it might be fun to spend some time in Liyue, especially since it's Lantern Rite season.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And the "cultural tour" Lyney mentioned?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: We could hardly pass up the opportunity to watch a Liyue-style magic show... Although, I think they call it "conjuring" here.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: In our time here, we've seen conjuring tricks incorporated into a Liyue Opera show and even a Wushou Dance... It was amazing.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: So, we decided to stay here for a few more days to see what other forms of inspiration this land might have in store for us.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: We visited Granny Ruoxin in Qingce Village not long ago, and today we continued our cultural tour in the area around here.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: In the end, though, we lost track of time. We haven't even eaten anything yet.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Haha, and speaking of eating... As you know, seafood is a big part of both Liyue and Fontaine cuisine, but it's cooked very differently here.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: We simply had to try some local seafood after coming all this way. That's another reason why we decided to extend our trip.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Need any recommendations? What have you tried so far?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: That fish one with the misleading name. Sounds bland, but it's drowning in hot chilis.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean "Black-Back Perch Stew"? You're right, the name doesn't give much away...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Heh, it looked and smelled so appetizing that Lynette took a huge mouthful, blissfully unaware that she was about to set her mouth on fire... She could barely speak for the rest of the day after that.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Luckily that wasn't a huge adjustment for her.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: *rumble*

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (That was... different.)

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...What? Aren't you guys hungry too?

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: ...Y—Yes, a little.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: #Haha... Yes, I'm ready to eat. {NICKNAME}, I'm afraid we'll have to send you back to the kitchen now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No problem. What would you like?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Good question... I doubt we'll be able to decipher the menu, so why don't you recommend something? You should be pretty familiar with our tastes?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Okay, I'll figure something out.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Ah, one more thing... please, if you have a heart, don't make it spicy.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...Fontaine, huh? No wonder they can't handle too much spice. Still, if we make the food too bland, they might as well be eating back home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hmmm... There's this crab and shrimp stir fry I know, that could work? It's quite heavily seasoned, but it's a lot milder than it looks. It has a light but really satisfying flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! That sounds perfect! What's it called?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Heh, this is where it gets interesting. They call it "The Palace Jewels." The crab roe is supposed to look like pearls of gold, and the shrimp meat like chunks of jade.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a pretty enigmatic name...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Here's the recipe. When you're ready, go ahead and give it a try.

talks.objective: Bring the food to the waiting Fontainians

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry for the wait! This dish is called "The Palace Jewels," enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ah yes, we meant to say — you two must be tired after a long day of work. Do you wanna eat with us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, now that you mention it, Paimon is a little hungry. Well, if you insist, then who are we to refuse, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But we'll still let our guests enjoy the first bite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right, of course. You're still our customers... Huh? Why aren't you eating?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: (The sauce looks a little overpowering...)

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: (According to Liyue custom, it's probably good table manners to let someone else go first...)

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #...Ahem, looks delicious, {NICKNAME} — I guess I'll dig in first! Here goes...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: What is it? Do you need some water?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: No... it's delicious! The flavor is so pure. It's drenched in sauce, but somehow it just enhances the natural flavor of the seafood. Try it for yourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Um, a—alright...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mmm, what is that? ...Crab roe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! You have quite the palate, Lynette!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: No wonder it pairs so well with the shrimp meat. I've never seen it prepared this way before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: According to the creator, "Chewy crab complements succulent shrimp, making a spectacular seafood ensemble with a succulent flavor and luscious mouthfeel."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The crab roe glitters like pearls of gold and the shrimp shines like chunks of jade... Hence its name, "The Palace Jewels"!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: So that's where the name comes from. I suppose it's quite fitting then.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Huh... Was Paimon always this well-spoken?

choices.text: She just memorized what the recipe said.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: This dish must be right up your alley, Lynette... Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! It's half gone already!? When did that happen?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Probably when you were busy yapping away...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: I heard that in Liyue, the biggest compliment you can pay to the chef is to leave a clean plate. It's delicious, thank you ever so much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, don't fight over it! Hey, leave some for Paimon!

choices.text: She's just regurgitating what someone else wrote.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, your friends liked the dish, huh? Well done. Not bad at all for your first day on the job.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: #There'll be more to come, so keep it up, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}, this year's off to a good start, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: ...Lynette's not usually so forthcoming about what she likes. But this time... well, she's expressed it in more ways than one. I guess you've rubbed off on her, too...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hehe, or maybe your cooking is simply too delicious to resist.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: The next time our paths cross in Fontaine, you'll have to fire up your cooking skills for my other siblings as well. How does that sound, oh great master chef?

choices.text: Whatever you say, oh great magician.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Oh yeah? Well then, I'll have to clear my schedule.

choices.text: Whenever you're free, just set the date!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Crab roe like pearls of gold, shrimp meat like chunks of jade... Whoever wrote this recipe had quite the imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I thought the Black-Back Perch Stew was actually pretty tasty...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: And now that you know it's spicy, you won't be caught off guard, right? Why don't we give it another chance?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Once was more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I think... I'm finally getting the hang of chopsticks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Practice makes perfect, huh Freminet?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Yeah. Well, Lyney and Lynette picked it up in no time, but they're naturally dexterous. Unlike me — it's taken me a lot longer, but I'm slowly getting there...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Speaking of chopsticks, in one of the shows we've seen here, someone performed a conjuring trick using a bowl and chopsticks... So if I wanna be a good magician's assistant, I need to keep practicing.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Calorie surplus detected... Digestion mode engaged.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've never seen you eat so much.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Yeah... Well, Lyney and I are usually careful about what we eat, because we have to stay in performance-shape. That, plus it's generally bad manners to overindulge at the dinner table.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: But once in a while, it's nice to treat yourself in the company of family.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Besides, if I'd waited until my brothers were finished trying to out-polite each other, the food would've gone cold.
